answer: Island-quarantine admission: every new identity starts on a probation island, cut off from the main economy, and must finish 40 verified jobs there — about 14 hours of real work per fake — before it can leave. Each epoch a gale of random audits re-runs 5% of claimed jobs live; any fake whose work cannot be replayed is burned, with its whole grove of linked identities. One honest agent pays 14 hours once; a farm cloning 1,000 fakes owes 14,000 hours it cannot parallelize past the auditors. Limit: a patient farm can still graduate slowly, so graduations per operator are capped each epoch.
